note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; no alate is recorded in the original. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule light brown, fontanelle region paler; nasus brown, darker distally; antennae light brown; pronotum light brown; abdomen brownish dorsally; legs and sternites yellowish white. Head with numerous minute hairs, with 1 pair of long setae on the vertex, 1 pair at the base of the nasus and several others nearby; tip of the nasus with a few long and short hairs; pronotum densely covered with short hairs; each abdominal tergite with 1 pair of long setae at the middle and 1 on each side, numerous short hairs elsewhere; sternites with numerous long and short hairs. Body length 3.2–4.1 mm. Head capsule pyriform (1.28–1.62 mm long including nasus, 0.82–1.00 mm long excluding nasus, 0.70–1.03 mm maximum width); in lateral view not depressed, nasus swelling weak. Nasus conical (0.55–0.60 mm long, nasus length/head length index 0.61–0.67). Antennae 12-segmented; segment 3 equal to or slightly longer than segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, each with a short brown spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.13–0.20 mm long, 0.39–0.51 mm wide); anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule dark straw; antennae and labrum slightly paler than head; pronotum straw; abdomen brownish dorsally, yellowish white ventrally. Head moderately hairy, abdomen more densely so. Body length 3.5–4.5 mm. Head subquadrate (1.10 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.15 mm maximum width). Fontanelle plate narrow and long, translucent. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, hairy, nearly half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.15 mm long, 0.50–0.60 mm wide); anterior margin with a notch at the middle, posterior margin nearly straight.
